URL: https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/07/tankers-saudi-crude-turn-back-houthis-open-new-front-us-iran-war
Reuters via Al-Monitor, 22 Jul 2026 — Two tankers with Saudi crude (bound China/India) reversed course in Red Sea after Houthi blockade threat, heading to Suez instead of Bab el-Mandeb. Houthis declared naval blockade on Saudi Arabia Monday, threatened to attack ships loading/discharging Saudi oil. Trump: "So far it hasn't happened. If something like that happens, we take care of it." Confirmed 18 US service members killed (4 recently in Jordan/Iraq). Brent above $91, US gasoline over $4/gal. 50 civilians killed, 500 wounded in recent US strikes (Iran health ministry). War began Feb 28. Iran struck Bahrain (Amazon data centre claim), Kuwait, Jordan; desalination plants hit raising water-shortage fears. UKMTO: tanker struck by projectile in Hormuz, crew abandoned ship. Iran received 10-day ceasefire proposal from mediators.
